images.label: Nexo nas Escolas
images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: preview-only concept photograph for a card on a Brazilian university civic-education website, Nexo Governamental. Generate exactly ONE standalone landscape image, 1536x1024, 3:2, highest photographic quality. This is a conceptual location, not documentation of an actual Nexo activity or an actual identified institution.
Style: quietly beautiful architectural/editorial photography, convincing natural materials, restrained warm late-afternoon light balanced with natural blues. Real camera optics, straight verticals, true textures and slight everyday imperfections, moderate natural contrast, carefully controlled highlights, no HDR or CGI gloss. Welcoming, credible and well maintained rather than ostentatious. Design a strong instantly readable central subject; safe crop for a website card around 1.6:1. No lettering, no typography, no logo, no watermark, no frame, no collage.
Absolute constraints: zero people anywhere, zero faces, zero human silhouettes, no human reflections, no figures on walls/screens. Do not add text or university insignia. No staged stock-photo clichés, no gloomy abandoned atmosphere, no artificial plastic polish.
Primary request: a welcoming contemporary Brazilian secondary-school classroom prepared for a participatory debate, empty and ready for students. Eight ordinary light-wood school desks with understated muted blue chairs form a generous open semicircle facing a clean blank chalkboard. A small, credible number of unbranded notebooks and simple pencils rest naturally on a few desks; paper has no visible writing. Modest pale painted walls, functional believable furniture, tall side windows reveal soft leafy green outdoors. Comfortable human scale, ordinary good Brazilian public-school facilities, not a luxury training center.
Composition: view from a gentle diagonal at seated-eye height, an inviting desk with a softly opened notebook in the lower foreground leads into the semicircle and board; the curve of desks communicates conversation and learning. The foreground is secondary, keep it low so it does not dominate. Airy lateral sunlight brings a subtle luminous pattern to the desks and floor, soft shadows, blue chairs balance the warm wooden tones. Clean composition with useful depth, elegant natural realism, attractive even as a small website thumbnail. Avoid perfectly repetitive desks, floating objects, excessive props, exaggerated sun beams or American classroom stereotypes.

Primary request: a beautiful but realistic Brazilian university auditorium prepared for an academic roundtable about law and public policy, completely empty. Main subject is a modest light-wood discussion table with exactly three simple slim black gooseneck conference microphones and three elegant navy upholstered chairs behind it, on a low platform. A few empty navy auditorium seats appear along the bottom foreground framing the view and establishing the venue. Warm wood acoustic panels, pale walls, and soft daylight entering tall side windows make the room dignified and inviting. Ordinary credible academic architecture, not a theater or luxurious corporate hall.
Composition: diagonal view from near the first audience row, the table and three chairs occupy the central middle band and are large enough to read in a small card. Foreground audience seat backs remain low and unobtrusive; one or two closed neutral notebooks on the table, no readable writing, no clutter. Restrained photographic depth while keeping the table, microphones and chairs sharply legible. Natural subtle golden lateral light across warm wood, daylight-balanced navy seating, gentle real shadow detail. Avoid giant empty blank screens, screens entirely if possible, banners, concert spotlights, dramatic stage darkness, excessive symmetry, exaggerated luxury, ostentatious chandeliers, repeated broken chair geometry.
